build.beforeBuildCommand: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const root = process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE || path.resolve(__dirname, '..'); const src = path.join(root, 'src'); if (!fs.existsSync(src)) { console.error('Missing frontend dir: ' + src); process.exit(1); } const install = spawnSync('npm', ['install'], { cwd: src, stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); if (install.status) process.exit(install.status); const build = spawnSync('npm', ['run', 'build'], { cwd: src, stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(build.status || 0);"
